user.title: Connect Kinosail
user.description: Enter the local Server address. Kinosail will open a secure Owner approval page. Use a one-time code only as a manual fallback.

confirm.title: Connect discovered Kinosail Server
confirm.description: Open {url} and approve this local connection as a Kinosail Owner.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Kinosail
reauth_confirm.description: Continue without a code to approve in Kinosail. Enter a new one-time code only when browser approval is unavailable.

reconfigure.title: Update Kinosail Server
reconfigure.description: Change this connection address or certificate setting. The new address must identify the same Kinosail Server.

error.cannot_connect: Could not pair with Kinosail. Check the address, certificate, and one-time code.
error.disabled: Home Assistant is disabled in Kinosail Settings.

abort.already_configured: This Kinosail Server is already connected.
abort.disabled: Home Assistant is disabled in Kinosail Settings.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered Kinosail Server sent invalid connection details.
abort.oauth_failed: Kinosail approval failed. Try connecting again or use a new one-time code.
